how: Not re-run. Numbers and sentences below were copied from the committed source note; the verdict is the line as written there.

verdict.label: relies entirely on a naive bootstrap CI of mean net R; DSR and PBO implemented in bt_stats.py are completely bypassed during interactive tuning; Trial Ledger cannot compute PBO.

why: Source: López de Prado, Marcos (2018), Advances in Financial Machine Learning, John Wiley & Sons, Chapter 7; and "The 10 Reasons Most Machine Learning Funds Fail", Journal of Portfolio Management, Vol. 44, No. 6, pp. 120–133.

> "Failing to account for overlapping outcomes leads to cross-validation leakage... when labels span multiple periods, standard cross-validation methods allow information from the testing set to leak into the training set."

Limitation: The ledger records only categorical metadata, parameter descriptions, and run statuses. It does not store per-bar or per-trade aligned return vectors across variants, precluding concurrent matrix operations like CSCV PBO.
